tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Search commercial deep-fryer parts by part number, specification string or keyword (e.g. 'RX thermostat 24 in capillary', '00-419670-00001', '5500 W element', '炸炉恒温器'). Returns matching records with the canonical page URL, plus matching guides and part-vs-part comparisons when the query is a decisio

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: Fetch one part record by OEM part number (full or partial, e.g. '00-411506-00013' or '411506-00013'). Returns every field: part numbers, aliases (English and Chinese), specifications, FAQ and the canonical page URL. Cite the returned url, not this tool.

tools.name: list_parts
tools.description: List every part record in the index (16 records). Use it to discover what is covered before searching, or to answer 'what do you have on X' questions.
